cost.author_time_and_cost_confirmation: author approved freezing and running A, A2 and B (180 calls) on: ~35 min sequential from the smoke (11.7 s/call), ~$0.15 expected (smoke $0.00085/call), $1.08 worst-case reservation, $3 hard stop
cost.projection_basis: 180 calls plus at most 180 retries at the reservation per call

schema_validity.measure: packets valid on the first attempt over all 180 packets (A, A2, B); attempts per packet
schema_validity.procedure: one pass, then one automatic retry pass over failed packets; still-failed packets stay unavailable and every pair with them is unavailable
schema_validity.threshold: >= 0.95 first-attempt valid; at most one retry (2 attempts) per packet

sham_balance.measure: run A derived O-S pair outcomes over the 20 cells: |S wins - O wins| (ties and unavailable pairs count for neither)

spread.measure: share of the 60 answers scoring 5 on every measure in run A (unavailable is not all-5)

stability.measure: run A vs run B: share of the 300 measure scores (60 answers x 5) within +-1 (a score missing in either run counts as not within), and share of the 20 cells with the same derived ranking (tie groups included; an unranked cell is not the same)
stability.reported_only: run A vs run A2 (identical rerun): identical outputs, scores and rankings
stability.threshold: >= 0.90 scores within +-1 and >= 0.80 cells same ranking

criteria_note: the four automated criteria and thresholds are copied unchanged from the 11e plan; schema validity counts all 180 packets

decision_rule.human_agreement: not_collected by author decision; the 11e rule's human conditions are dropped and the decision is final on the automated criteria (not provisional)
decision_rule.qualified_for_triage: every automated criterion (sham_balance, stability, spread, schema_validity) passes

disclosures.configuration: third scorer configuration on these same 60 11b answers (11e: qwen3:14b think false, failed spread 59/60 all-5; 11f: qwen3:14b think true, failed spread 37/60 all-5). Only the scorer model changes; prompt v2, schema v2, ranking rule, criteria, thresholds, seeds and answers are unchanged. One configuration is frozen here and not adjusted after outputs are seen.
disclosures.reproducibility: closed model: no digest pin. The model string the API reports, response ids, request settings and full responses are saved; A vs A2 measures nondeterminism.
disclosures.self_grading: gpt-6-luna wrote the 60 answers it scores. Every arm is a Luna answer, so self-preference shifts all arms alike; it is reported, not corrected.

frozen_before: any scorer call on the 60 answers in this configuration (only the toy-schema probe, with no study data, and the one-answer smoke in artifacts/pilot-11b-v3-scorer-v2-luna-smoke with seed 3 exist; the smoke's scores were not read)

human_agreement.authority: author decision in chat, 2026-10-08: close the refinement experiment with no human graders; the decision rests on the automated criteria only

ranking.definition: within a cell, compare two answers measure by measure in priority order; the first measure where |difference| >= margin decides; smaller or equal differences fall through; no deciding measure is a tie; per-cell ranks by net wins; cycles checked and reported; computed on opaque labels before unblinding
ranking.unavailable: an answer without a valid score after one retry makes every pair with it unavailable and its cell unranked

reports: per-arm means per measure (A; B beside)
derived R0-vs-O, S-vs-O and S-vs-R0 wins/ties/losses
sham S-O score differences per measure for replicate sizing
no significance tests and no effect claims

A.role: base run: sham balance, spread, ranking, rubric agreement

A2.role: identical repeat of A (same packets and order; the API has no seed): nondeterminism, reported only

B.role: reference notes shuffled per question: stability criterion

scope: exploratory: scorer v2 (designed after the frozen 11b no-go) with gpt-6-luna as the scorer; never changes the 11b decision; not answer-quality or restructuring-effect evidence for the paper

scorer.completion_rule: an attempt whose response status is not 'completed', or with a refusal or no output text, is failed (retry rule applies)
scorer.validity: local jsonschema validation against schema v2 (unchanged), as in 11e

seeds.notes_rule: run B only: per question, random.Random(int(sha256('<notes_seed>|notes|<question_id>'))) shuffles the note order, reshuffled while identity
seeds.sampling: the Responses API has no seed; A2 is an identical repeat of A
seeds.uses: answer labels and run order, identical to 11e (packets asserted identical to the 11e packets of the same run before any call)
